title: Give each browser-suite run its own evidence directory (OC-4)
objective: Both browser suites overwrite docs/batch-l-evidence/ by default simply by running; Batch L's recorded evidence was overwritten and restored from Git during the night-of work. A default that destroys another batch's evidence is a trap. Give each run its own directory (an ignored, timestamped location by default; a named docs/ directory only when a batch record asks for it). Source: former tracker row OC-4, preserved in docs/archive/TASK-TRACKER-2026-09-19-pre-readoption.md.
acceptance: Running tests/ui3-browser.mjs and tests/s1-browser.mjs with no arguments writes under an ignored per-run directory and leaves docs/batch-*-evidence/ untouched; git status is clean afterwards.
A documented option writes to a named directory for a batch record; docs/VALIDATION.md says which.
non_goals: No change to what the suites test.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.

handoff.next_action: Find the evidence-directory default in both suites, then move it behind an option with an ignored timestamped default.
